# jamfprotect_prevent_list_set (Resource)

Manages a prevent list set in Jamf Protect. Prevent list sets group custom prevent lists and scope them to plans, in the same way analytic sets scope analytics.

A custom prevent list reaches an endpoint only when it belongs to a prevent list set that is assigned to that endpoint's plan. Assign prevent list sets to a plan with the `prevent_list_sets` attribute on `jamfprotect_plan`.

~> A prevent list set that is assigned to a plan cannot be deleted. Remove it from every plan first, or Terraform will report an error on destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Prevent List Set
# Prevent list sets group custom prevent lists and scope them to plans. A custom
# prevent list reaches an endpoint only when it belongs to a prevent list set
# assigned to that endpoint's plan.

resource "jamfprotect_custom_prevent_list" "trusted_teams" {
  name         = "Trusted Team IDs"
  description  = "Team IDs of vendors approved for this fleet"
  prevent_type = "Team ID"

  list_data = [
    "ABC1234567",
    "XYZ9876543",
  ]
}

resource "jamfprotect_custom_prevent_list" "blocked_hashes" {
  name         = "Blocked File Hashes"
  description  = "SHA-256 hashes of known malware samples"
  prevent_type = "File Hash"

  list_data = [
    "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
  ]
}

resource "jamfprotect_prevent_list_set" "endpoint_baseline" {
  name        = "Endpoint Baseline"
  description = "Prevent lists applied to every managed Mac"

  prevent_lists = [
    jamfprotect_custom_prevent_list.trusted_teams.id,
    jamfprotect_custom_prevent_list.blocked_hashes.id,
  ]
}

# Example: Assigning a prevent list set to a plan
# Prevent list sets do nothing until a plan references them.

resource "jamfprotect_plan" "baseline" {
  name                 = "Baseline Plan"
  description          = "Plan that applies the baseline prevent lists"
  action_configuration = jamfprotect_action_configuration.example.id
  reporting_interval   = 60

  prevent_list_sets = [
    jamfprotect_prevent_list_set.endpoint_baseline.id,
  ]
}

resource "jamfprotect_action_configuration" "example" {
  name        = "Baseline Action Configuration"
  description = "Action configuration for the baseline plan"
}

# Example: A prevent list set with no members
# Valid, and ships no prevent lists. Useful as a placeholder that plans can
# reference before the lists themselves are decided.

resource "jamfprotect_prevent_list_set" "placeholder" {
  name          = "Placeholder Set"
  description   = "Reserved for future prevent lists"
  prevent_lists = []
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the prevent list set.
- `prevent_lists` (Set of String) A set of custom prevent list IDs to include in this prevent list set. An empty set is allowed and ships no prevent lists. Jamf Protect rejects IDs that do not exist.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the prevent list set.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the prevent list set.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform 1.5+ Import Example
# Import an existing Jamf Protect prevent list set using the import block.
#
# Tenants that had custom prevent lists before prevent list sets existed have their
# lists migrated into sets automatically by Jamf Protect. Import one if you want
# Terraform to manage it.

import {
  to = jamfprotect_prevent_list_set.imported
  id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
}

resource "jamfprotect_prevent_list_set" "imported" {
  # Configuration will be populated during import
  # After import, run 'terraform plan' to see the current state
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright Jamf Software LLC 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

terraform import jamfprotect_prevent_list_set.example "<prevent-list-set-id>"
```
